# Evidence

This folder holds proof that the stack was deployed and behaves as designed.
Capture these during a deployment session (see `docs/runbook.md`), commit them,
then destroy the environment. **Redact** account IDs, emails and IPs you don't
want public before committing screenshots.

## Checklist

### Generated by scripts (commit as-is)

- [ ] `security-validation-<timestamp>.txt` - `scripts/validate-security.sh`, all PASS
- [ ] `scaling-<timestamp>.csv` - `scripts/watch-scaling.sh` during the load test
- [ ] `k6-summary.json` - `k6 run --summary-export ...`

### Screenshots (save as PNG in `screenshots/`)

- [ ] `01-terraform-apply-complete.png` - final lines of `terraform apply` with outputs
- [ ] `02-site-https.png` - WordPress over HTTPS with the padlock / certificate details
- [ ] `03-vpc-resource-map.png` - VPC > Your VPCs > Resource map (subnets, route tables, gateways)
- [ ] `04-ecs-service-tasks.png` - ECS service showing tasks in 3 AZs, private IPs only
- [ ] `05-rds-multi-az.png` - RDS instance: Multi-AZ = Yes, Encryption = Enabled, Publicly accessible = No
- [ ] `06-secrets-in-task-definition.png` - task definition JSON showing `secrets` / `valueFrom`, no password
- [ ] `07-waf-rules.png` - Web ACL rules list and the ALB association
- [ ] `08-dashboard-under-load.png` - CloudWatch dashboard during the k6 run (CPU, tasks, requests)
- [ ] `09-scaling-activity.png` - ECS service > Events showing scale-out then scale-in
- [ ] `10-alarm-email.png` - an SNS alarm email (e.g. CPU high during the test)
- [ ] `11-rds-failover-events.png` - RDS events from the forced-failover drill
- [ ] `12-github-actions-green.png` - CI run with all jobs passing
- [ ] `13-budget.png` - AWS Budgets showing the $50 budget and alerts

### Results to write into the README

Once captured, replace the "Results" placeholders in the top-level README with
the measured numbers: peak tasks, time to scale out, p95 latency under load,
error rate, and RDS failover duration.
